title: Reunion Count me out!
paragraphs: What is it about reunions that make some people reluctant to go to? Is it that they're afraid of being judged by people who they met in their heyday? Is it a fear of having betrayed high expectations? Or is it the risk of realising that the sparkle that held the group together is no longer there?

Fans have been keen on a Spice Girls reunion, but Posh Spice is saying 'no'. Fans have eagerly followed months of speculation about the five British singers getting together again. For this generation - now mainly middle aged mothers - it's a chance to introduce the band to their own daughters. But, unfortunately, it's not gonna happen. They might see four of them.

The spoil sport seems to be Victoria Beckham. Maybe Posh Spice became too posh herself to shake her booty on a stage. She's said in the past that she's got no plans to join with Baby, Scary, Ginger and Sporty.
"Doing the Olympics was an incredible honour. That's great. Thank you to everybody, but no more," she said after the group performed at the closing ceremony of the Olympic Games in London in 2012.

And then there's Friends. Well, no more chats at the (fictitious) Central Perk cafe for Chandler Bing. Actor Matthew Perry has announced that he won't attend the reunion show of the hit American TV sitcom which captured the imagination of audiences in several countries. It ended in 2004 after ten series.

Perry's spokesperson said he "may tape something" as a tribute to the series' creator James Burrows but... he is otherwise engaged. As some Hollywood actors do, he will star in a play in London which runs until May. It's a story about being middle aged. Enough said.

vocabulary.entry: reunion [n.] /riːˈjuːnjən/ 重聚；团聚 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: The family reunion was held at a hotel by the sea.
vocabulary.translation: 家庭聚会在海边的一家酒店举行。

vocabulary.entry: reluctant [adj.] /rɪˈlʌktənt/ 不情愿的；勉强的 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: She was reluctant to admit that she was wrong.
vocabulary.translation: 她不愿意承认自己错了。

vocabulary.entry: heyday [n.] /ˈheɪdeɪ/ 鼎盛时期；全盛期 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: In his heyday, he was one of the best football players in the world.
vocabulary.translation: 在他的鼎盛时期，他是世界上最好的足球运动员之一。

vocabulary.entry: betray [v.] /bɪˈtreɪ/ 辜负；背叛 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: He felt he had betrayed his parents' trust.
vocabulary.translation: 他觉得辜负了父母的信任。

vocabulary.entry: sparkle [n.] /ˈspɑːkəl/ 闪光点；魅力 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: The performance lacked its usual sparkle.
vocabulary.translation: 这场演出缺乏它惯有的魅力。

vocabulary.entry: be keen on [phr.] /biː kiːn ɒn/ 热衷于；喜爱 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: She is very keen on learning to play the piano.
vocabulary.translation: 她非常热衷于学习弹钢琴。

vocabulary.entry: speculation [n.] /ˌspekjʊˈleɪʃən/ 推测；猜测 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: There has been a lot of speculation about his resignation.
vocabulary.translation: 关于他的辞职有很多猜测。

vocabulary.entry: spoil sport [n.] /spɔɪl spɔːt/ 扫兴的人 (口语；固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: Don't be such a spoil sport – come to the party with us!
vocabulary.translation: 别这么扫兴，跟我们一起去派对吧！

vocabulary.entry: shake one's booty [phr.] /ʃeɪk wʌnz ˈbuːti/ 扭动屁股跳舞 (口语；俚语)
vocabulary.example: The dancers shook their booties to the rhythm of the music.
vocabulary.translation: 舞者们随着音乐节奏扭动屁股。

vocabulary.entry: incredible [adj.] /ɪnˈkredəbəl/ 难以置信的；极好的 (口语)
vocabulary.example: The view from the top of the mountain was incredible.
vocabulary.translation: 山顶的景色美得令人难以置信。

vocabulary.entry: honour [n.] /ˈɒnə/ 荣誉 (英式拼写，美式: honor)
vocabulary.example: It is a great honour to be invited to speak here today.
vocabulary.translation: 今天被邀请在这里发言是极大的荣誉。

vocabulary.entry: fictitious [adj.] /fɪkˈtɪʃəs/ 虚构的 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: All the characters in the novel are fictitious.
vocabulary.translation: 小说中的所有人物都是虚构的。

vocabulary.entry: sitcom [n.] /ˈsɪtkɒm/ 情景喜剧 (专业词汇；缩写)
vocabulary.example: Friends is one of the most popular sitcoms of all time.
vocabulary.translation: 《老友记》是有史以来最受欢迎的情景喜剧之一。

vocabulary.entry: capture the imagination of [phr.] /ˈkæptʃə ði ɪˌmædʒɪˈneɪʃən əv/ 激发……的想象力；吸引……的注意 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: The story of the young wizard captured the imagination of children worldwide.
vocabulary.translation: 这个年轻巫师的故事吸引了全世界孩子们的想象力。

vocabulary.entry: tribute [n.] /ˈtrɪbjuːt/ 致敬；颂词 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: The concert was a tribute to the legendary musician.
vocabulary.translation: 这场音乐会是对那位传奇音乐家的致敬。

vocabulary.entry: be engaged [phr.] /biː ɪnˈɡeɪdʒd/ 忙于；从事 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: He is currently engaged in writing his second novel.
vocabulary.translation: 他目前正忙于写他的第二部小说。

vocabulary.entry: star in [phr.] /stɑːr ɪn/ 主演；在……中担任主角 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: She will star in a new action movie next year.
vocabulary.translation: 她明年将主演一部新的动作片。

vocabulary.entry: middle aged [adj.] /ˌmɪdəl ˈeɪdʒd/ 中年的
vocabulary.example: The play is about the struggles of a middle aged couple.
vocabulary.translation: 这部戏剧讲述了一对中年夫妇的挣扎。

vocabulary.entry: enough said [phr.] /ɪˈnʌf sed/ 无需多言 (口语；固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: He's always late, never prepared, and easily distracted. Enough said.
vocabulary.translation: 他总是迟到，从不准备，还容易分心。不用多说了。

vocabulary.entry: eagerly [adv.] /ˈiːɡəli/ 热切地；渴望地
vocabulary.example: Fans eagerly awaited the release of the new album.
vocabulary.translation: 粉丝们热切地等待着新专辑的发行。

sentences.english: What is it about reunions that make some people reluctant to go to?
sentences.chinese: 是什么让一些人不愿意参加重聚活动呢？

sentences.english: Is it that they're afraid of being judged by people who they met in their heyday?
sentences.chinese: 是因为他们害怕被那些在自己鼎盛时期结识的人评判吗？

sentences.english: Is it a fear of having betrayed high expectations?
sentences.chinese: 是担心辜负了人们的高期望吗？

sentences.english: Or is it the risk of realising that the sparkle that held the group together is no longer there?
sentences.chinese: 还是害怕意识到曾经将大家凝聚在一起的那种闪光点已经不复存在了呢？

sentences.english: Fans have been keen on a Spice Girls reunion, but Posh Spice is saying 'no'.
sentences.chinese: 粉丝们一直渴望辣妹合唱团重组，但是“优雅辣妹”却表示拒绝。

sentences.english: Fans have eagerly followed months of speculation about the five British singers getting together again.
sentences.chinese: 粉丝们热切关注了数月来有关这五位英国歌手再次聚首的各种猜测。

sentences.chinese: 对于这一代人——现在主要是中年妈妈们——这是一个向自己女儿介绍这个乐队的机会。

sentences.english: But, unfortunately, it's not gonna happen.
sentences.chinese: 但不幸的是，这不会发生了。

sentences.english: They might see four of them.
sentences.chinese: 她们或许只能看到其中四位成员。

sentences.english: The spoil sport seems to be Victoria Beckham.
sentences.chinese: 扫兴的人似乎是维多利亚·贝克汉姆。

sentences.english: Maybe Posh Spice became too posh herself to shake her booty on a stage.
sentences.chinese: 也许“优雅辣妹”变得太过高雅，以至于不愿意在舞台上扭动屁股了。

sentences.english: She's said in the past that she's got no plans to join with Baby, Scary, Ginger and Sporty.
sentences.chinese: 她过去曾表示，她没有计划与“宝贝辣妹”“疯狂辣妹”“姜汁辣妹”和“运动辣妹”重聚。

sentences.english: "Doing the Olympics was an incredible honour.
sentences.chinese: “能够在奥运会上表演是一项难以置信的荣誉。

sentences.english: That's great.
sentences.chinese: 那很棒。

sentences.english: Thank you to everybody, but no more," she said after the group performed at the closing ceremony of the Olympic Games in London in 2012.
sentences.chinese: 感谢每一个人，但不会再有下一次了。”2012年，辣妹合唱团在伦敦奥运会闭幕式上表演后，她这样说道。

sentences.english: And then there's Friends.
sentences.chinese: 然后就是《老友记》。

sentences.chinese: 嗯，钱德勒·宾再也不会在（虚构的）中央公园咖啡馆里聊天了。

sentences.english: Actor Matthew Perry has announced that he won't attend the reunion show of the hit American TV sitcom which captured the imagination of audiences in several countries.
